cards.front: TEST CARD: where did this card come from?
cards.back: From the "Test flashcards" content pack. It only exists to show how pack cards arrive: unverified, with a reference. Retire it when you are done trying the feature.
cards.reference: content/cards-test.json (the test pack in this app's repository)

cards.front: TEST CARD: explain in your own words why cards from a content pack arrive unverified.
cards.back: The app never marks a card verified for you. Only you can, after checking it against its reference. Retire this card when you are done trying the feature.
cards.reference: content/cards-test.json (the test pack in this app's repository)
